steps.name: ${_DOCKER_BUILDER_IMAGE}
args: [[ "$$REVIEWED_TAG" =~ ^review-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,90}$$ ]] || { echo 'Reviewed image tag required'; exit 2; }; [[ "$$PYTHON_BASE_IMAGE" =~ ^python:3\.11-slim@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$$ ]] || { echo 'Reviewed Python base digest required'; exit 2; }; [[ "$$SOURCE_CHECKSUMS_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$$ ]] || { echo 'Reviewed source checksum digest required'; exit 2; }; printf '%s  SHA256SUMS\n' "$$SOURCE_CHECKSUMS_SHA256" | sha256sum -c -; sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS; exec docker build --file deploy/history-production.Dockerfile --build-arg "PYTHON_BASE=$$PYTHON_BASE_IMAGE" --tag "${_IMAGE}:$$REVIEWED_TAG" .
